**Tags:** `vault`, `sandbox`, `raft`

## Learning objectives

- Get comfortable with the run page, the Cluster and Logs tabs, terminals and node actions.
- Explore Vault features freely.

## Prerequisites

- None. A Vault Enterprise license in Settings is needed for the Enterprise edition.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Vault version | version |  | The version to run. It defaults to the newest. |
| Edition | edition | community | Community, or Enterprise, which needs a license saved in Settings. |
| Node count | int | 3 | How many Vault nodes to run, from 1 to 9. |

## Initial state

One network and the chosen number of Vault nodes on Raft integrated storage, initialised with five key shares and a threshold of three, unsealed, with the audit log enabled. For Enterprise the license from Settings is applied. The Cluster tab shows the addresses, the root token and the unseal keys.

## Steps

This scenario has no steps. It is an open-ended sandbox, so it runs until you end it.
